4.why: src/Operon.cpp:180-181 clamp(getVoltage(), -10, 10)*0.5 added to gene 1's transcription

comment: Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so the module is monophonic. The three protein outputs share one line and the three gate outputs share another: they carry the same quantity for a different gene and differ by number alone. The panel prints GATE, but the pulse is a fixed 1ms trigger rather than a gate that stays high for a phase of the cycle. The CV depths differ per destination (6, 0.6 and 0.5 units per volt) rather than the tenth-of-range used elsewhere in the plugin; the manual says only "scale-appropriate depths".
